claims.text: The model achieves the best performance for predicting both implicit and explicit discourse relations simultaneously.
The full model achieves a macro-average F1-score of 48.82% for predicting implicit discourse relations, which is an improvement over previous models.
The model shows improved performance specifically on the contingency relation, indicating it works well for this type of discourse relation.
The model's performance for explicit discourse relations is comparable to previous best results, indicating it performs well but not as strongly as for implicit relations.
